backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining user profiles, stats, availability, posts, reactions, and various queries with access control and storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking a leaderboard date-source update to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of autogenerated summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration defining light/dark theme variables and base styles.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point setting up PWA meta tags, icons, and root mounting element.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, icons, theme colors, and startup behavior.
frontend/public/offline.html: Standalone offline fallback page with minimal styling and retry button.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing precaching, cache cleanup, and network-first fetch handling with offline fallback.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines routing and an AuthGate that manages auth state, loading, error handling, and session initialization before rendering app pages.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Shows an access denied message with a link back to the calendar for non-admin users.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Displays the login UI with Internet Identity sign-in and app branding.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppLogo: Renders the application logo using branding metadata.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Implements the group chat view with message loading, thread rendering, posting, and image upload support.
frontend/src/components/chat/ImageAttach: Provides image file selection, validation, preview, and clearing for message attachments.
frontend/src/components/chat/ReactionCon: Handles like/dislike reactions on posts with optimistic updates and backend mutation calls.
frontend/src/components/chat/ReplyCompos: Form for composing threaded replies with optional image attachments and upload progress.
frontend/src/components/chat/ThreadedPos: Renders a recursive threaded post tree with avatar, reactions, replies, and optional reply composer.
frontend/src/components/common/ErrorStat: Displays an error alert with optional retry and secondary action buttons.
frontend/src/components/common/LoadingSt: Provides full-page and inline loading indicators with configurable sizes and messages.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with top bar, navigation, content area, and footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Renders navigation tabs with icons and conditional admin link based on user role.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageLayou: Provides page container and header components with configurable max width and optional actions.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: Displays the app's top bar with logo, theme toggle, PWA install prompt, and user menu including logout.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileC: Shows and allows editing of user profile details including name and profile picture with upload handling.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileL: Displays the caller's leaderboard rank with loading skeleton fallback.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Shows the user's match history with loading, error, and empty states.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: A modal prompting new users to enter and save their display name.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallInstr: Dialog component showing iOS or Android-specific PWA installation steps.
frontend/src/components/pwa/OfflineBanne: Displays a banner when the user is offline using browser online/offline events.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: Wraps content with a fixed low-opacity background image layout.
Renders a user avatar with initials fallback and a display name, supporting sizes and loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on Internet Identity, invalidating queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Queries and updates the caller's user profile using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Fetches the caller’s role and admin status via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication state, login, and logout through a React context.
frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstallPrompt.t: Manages PWA install prompt availability, iOS detection, and triggering installation.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of hooks to fetch user profiles, availability, stats, posts, and related backend data.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Manages light/dark theme state with localStorage persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch user display names and avatars by principal, with fallbacks when profiles are missing.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light/dark themes plus layout and safe-area adjustments.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports centralized app branding constants including name and logo metadata.
frontend/src/lib/chatThreads.ts: Builds nested thread structures from flat post lists and provides a function to flatten them with depth info.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Utility functions for day IDs, date conversion, month grids, formatting, and day comparisons.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React Query, identity provider, and rendering the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: Page for adding or editing user availability with time selection, notes, and form submission logic.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard showing users and availabilities with delete actions and permission checks.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: Renders a monthly calendar grid with availability counts and navigation, plus an embedded chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Displays a standalone group chat page with a header and chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: Shows availability details for a specific date, allowing users to add or delete their availability.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Displays the leaderboard, available days, and tools to record wins/losses with rank change notifications.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Shows the user’s profile, leaderboard rank, and recent match history.
frontend/src/utils/file.ts: Provides helpers for file-to-bytes conversion, generating initials, and validating image uploads.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters and session-stored values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom colors, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state file tracking versions, known issues, and feature requests for fixing leaderboard date availability logic.
